pictures.c: Distribution of the main post-orogenic basins that formed in Tuscany during the Pliocene-Quaternary (from Costantini et al. [1982]). Key: B.V.F) Bacino della Val di Fine; a) normal fault; b) tectonic lineament; 1) Livorno-Pistoia Line.

pictures.t: Location of Plio-Quaternary basins,  gas vents and associated waters
pictures.c: Geochemical signature of Plio-Quaternary basins of the Northern Apennines. In the Val di Fine basin the He3/He4 ratio is in the range 0.14-0.16. This ratio is very sensitive to deep fluids rising from the mantle (from Minissale et al. [2000]).

pictures.t: Heat flow, hot springs and gas emissions
pictures.c: Depth of the k-horizon and gas and hot water sources (from Piccardi et al. [2017]).

pictures.t: Active faults and perspective view of the Orciano Pisano fault
pictures.c: A) Capable faults in the Livorno Hills-Val di Fine area and projection of the "Orciano Pisano" Individual Source onto the surface (in orange). B) Perspective view of the eastern slope of the Livorno Hills showing the possible surface expression of the "Orciano Pisano" Individual Source (from Digital Terrain Model; Piccardi et al. [2017]).
